positions.name: AtlasRollbackCadenceMandate
positions.frame: What cadence governs Atlas rollback rehearsals, and by what authority is it fixed?
positions.why: src-1 issues the monthly cadence as a directive sealed by an aphorism that makes an unrehearsed rollback count as no rollback at all; src-2 restates the same cadence in flat label-and-value form, as a settled parameter rather than a proposal. Read together, the directive voice and its documented restatement both describe the same authority-set monthly cadence — one performing the mandate, the other recording it as fact. No tension between them; the register shift (aphoristic vs. matter-of-fact) is the same commitment stated twice.
